columns.name: earned_epoch
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN (type = 'refund'::rewardtype) THEN spendable_epoch
    ELSE
    CASE
        WHEN (spendable_epoch >= 2) THEN (spendable_epoch - 2)
        ELSE (0)::bigint
    END
END
